description: Use when an agent compares one coin's perp basis on DEX venues only (Hyperliquid, dYdX v4, GMX v2, Lighter, Paradex; no CEX). Input: coin, optional venues. Output: JSON per venue mark, index/oracle, premium %, annualized funding, OI USD; max-min funding spread; carry pairs ranked by funding spread. Derived statistics, not investment advice; fees and risk ignored. Example: ?coin=BTC Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

coin.description: Base symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL. Not listed on any selected venue → 404 (not charged)

venues.description: Comma list of hyperliquid, dydx, gmx, lighter, paradex (default all)

name: crypto_perp_basis
title: Perp basis across DEX venues: mark vs index premium, annualized funding, funding spread and carry pairs
